intent: An original adult woman curator, age 42, in a sunlit elevated fantasy library garden looks up after a gust carries a loose page toward the balcony. A vertical summer frame combining soft shaded character styling with large architectural depth.

scene.summary: View downward at about 25 degrees from the next stair landing, medium-full portrait in 9:16. In the lower middle foreground the curator sits by an open book under an ivory linen awning. Dark blue-black hair in a low looped bun with one small pale ceramic flower fastener, a few wind-loosened face strands; natural mature facial detail, restrained warm brown liner and berry-rose lip color. Her fully opaque ivory sleeveless high-neck dress has a navy silk belt and a loosely worn light gray-lilac linen jacket with botanical stitching only at its cuffs. One hand keeps the book open while the other reaches toward a single blank-backed page caught against the nearby railing; she looks up toward the approaching camera-side helper. Beyond her, a tall cascade of open white timber reading galleries and stone steps descends into a bright blue mountain lake, distant bridges populated by small readers. Soft canopy shade preserves face tone; bright sky and lake lift the background, small leaf shadows belong only to the tabletop and paving. Keep age and individual face, original non-branded costume, no halo or exact source pose.
